    target = int(input())
    power_level = 0
    while pow(base, power_level) < target:
        power_level += 1
    if pow(base, power_level) == target:
        print("YES")

    max_power_value = int(pow(base, power_level))
    sum_series = (max_power_value - 1) // (base - 1)

        print("NO")

def check_divisibility_path(base, target):
    if target == 1:
        return True
    if target % base == 0:
        return check_divisibility_path(base, target // base)
    elif (target - 1) % base == 0:
        return check_divisibility_path(base, (target - 1) // base)
    elif (target + 1) % base == 0:
        return check_divisibility_path(base, (target + 1) // base)
    return False

if __name__ == "__main__":
